2e39efcef5.q: What is The Folson Group and what services does it provide to condominium and co-op boards?
2e39efcef5.a: The Folson Group is a consulting firm co-owned by Mark and Tina Foley that helps condominium and co-op boards manage their buildings more effectively. d871028b0d.q: What was Mark Foley's first job and how did it shape his work ethic?
d871028b0d.a: Mark's first job during college was as a tofu presser at a startup in Fitchburg, Massachusetts, where he would separate curds from whey and press moisture from tofu by hand. The company gave him a $50 bonus every month just for showing up on time, which in 1979 was substantial money, and he appreciated the independent work and above-minimum-wage pay.
